approval_flag_used.meaning: Documented, non-dangerous Codex CLI flag: 'Route approval requests through automatic review using the workspace-write sandbox.' This was required because, under the default approval policy, Codex's safety layer blocks MCP tool calls pending approval even when --skip-git-repo-check and approval_policy=never are set for shell commands -- MCP tool calls have their own approval gate.
approval_flag_used.not_used: --dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox was deliberately NOT used, since it is documented as 'EXTREMELY DANGEROUS' and bypasses sandboxing broadly, not just MCP tool approval.
